detail: NPX and E180X applied; four-arm experiment completed on jiyujia Tesla T4.
adduct_assumption: The organizer provides measured polarity, not ion species. For all scans use the same label-independent direct proton assumption; no reference to true mass. Ramps are one experimental spectrum with endpoints in eV.
reported_coverage: Observed full-group holdout shared by all four arms; each query is evaluated once. Frozen public pretrained weights retain any historic unreported exposure.

msg_overlap.scope: Published MassSpecGym folds, exact normalized identity. Exposure in other pretrained weights and shared scaffolds requires separate evidence.

v1_failure.location: NPX training feature preparation, before the four-arm models
v1_failure.verified_snapshot_membership: Both archived CSVs have 17 IDs, 425 slots, and equal per-query SMILES multisets; E180X changed order in six.

recovery.input: v1 submission_pre_e180x.csv after upstream stages and before NPX changed any order

metrics.notes: Rank 0 denotes a miss. All questions remain in the denominator. Acyclic structures form one shared group for uncertainty; see holdout manifest for source/family exposure.

baseline.scope: 0.505 v7 complete scoring pipeline with masked spectral references and fold-restricted on-the-fly fits; structure-only candidate inventory preserved. Original frozen pretrained models are unchanged and may share historical chemical families.

diagnostics.scope: Readback diagnostic on the fixed v2 panel; unweighted structure scores are descriptive and no weight was selected.

decision: Do not expand this configuration. No truth rank changes across 17 identities; assess formulas on a new external cohort with measured competing-formula errors, and require independent net first-place/top-five and MRR gain before scaling.
